On Line 31 of Part VII of my initial report | listed PPL Corp. which | owned for a short time during the reporting period (1/1/14 - 3/22-15), but sold it on January

7.2014. The value on the date of sale was less than $15,000 and I realized a gain between $1000 and $2500. 1 inadvertantly failed to dislcose that this stock was

sold, Because | did not own this stock at any time during the current reporting period, it does not appear in Part VII of this report.

In Part VIL, in relation to the 401K #1, 403(b) #1, 403 (b) #2, Roth IRA #1 and Roth IRA #2, these retirement and investment funds, with the exception of the fund

listed on line 47, do not credit income to the mvidual accounts but stead report a “unit value” to participants. For those funds where no income 1s reported as

having been credited to my accounts, Column B(1) is blank and "None™ is entered on Column B(2).

Tn Part VII, in relation to Trust #1, the trust was terminated and the assets were transferred to the beneficiary. There was no gain on the transaction as none of the

assets were sold but rather were transferred.
